Title: Joe Biden faced criticism for flouting his own pandemic regulations when he attended a friend's birthday party in Manhattan in November 2020

Content: 
According to reports from November 2020, then-Vice President Joe Biden attended a birthday party in Manhattan while publicly advocating for strict adherence to pandemic protocols. This event drew criticism as it appeared to contradict the very guidelines he was promoting to the public during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.

The incident raises questions about political consistency and the application of rules for public officials versus ordinary citizens during national health crises.
